title: Specializations of symplectic and van Geemen--Sarti involutions on K3 surfaces
summary: Given a symplectic involution $ι$ on a K3 surface $X$, the desingularization $Y$ of $X/ι$ is still a K3 surface, which in general has a different Néron--Severi group. Nevertheless, if the involution is induced by the translation by a 2-torsion section on an elliptic fibration (i.e. it is a van Geemen--Sarti involution) and the Picard number is minimal, the Néron--Severi groups of $X$ and $Y$ are known to be isometric.
